speed_rule: For every case, candidate headless loft seconds must be <= baseline loft seconds * speed_max_ratio (at least 10% faster than main f759bde1 on this machine). Absolute 10-15s is recorded, not a pass threshold.
stl_rule: SHA-256 of the full exported STL byte string must equal the baseline export of the same fixture. Equal length or equal triangle count with any byte difference fails.
log_rule: executeCadOperatorProduction, on a finished foot that materializes and slices, must emit one JSON log object whose loft_s and slice_s are finite numbers greater than 0 and whose side matches the row.
